correctness.rationale: For every star with m>=2 positive spoke conductances, the Schur complement of I+tL has hub inverse diagonal R00=1/(1+sum_i x_i), x_i=tw_i/(1+tw_i), and strictly larger leaf inverse diagonals Rii-R00=sum_{j!=i}x_j/[(1+tw_i)(1+sum x_j)]. Since C(h)=2R-I, off-diagonal entries are nonnegative and positivity is equivalent to sum_i x_i<=1, including equality. Strict monotonicity gives a unique positive t*. Jensen strict concavity at fixed W gives t*>=m/((m-1)W), equality only at uniform weights. On weights (W-(m-1)epsilon,epsilon,...,epsilon), the exact quadratic gives t*~1/sqrt((m-1)W epsilon). Independently verified 9 exact rational resolvent matrices using direct SymPy inversions; inspected original 525-star verifier, which is corroboration, not a universal proof.
